Wash infrequently, usually after about 5 to 10 wears unless needed sooner
Turn it inside out
Wash in cold water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent
Remove it promptly after washing
Air dry whenever possible after gently reshaping it while damp

That routine is the best way to help preserve the fit, color, stretch, and overall fabric quality.
